objective: For a supplied original rank-r observation, characterize exactly when each product name has an affine Boolean representative on each of the 2^r cases; implement the syntactic repair and test sharpness, failure and route transport.
status: Proved: A fixed observation of rank r removes all names on the full Boolean cube when on every case each successive pair of affine factors has a constant factor or constant sum. The resulting formal degree-two conversion uses 2^r cases regardless of depth. The rank bound is sharp in general and a minimum such observation up to rank r can be found in O(6^r poly(N)) work.
title: Which fixed cases support an affine interpretation of every named product
